'''Deputy of Arkham''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

An [[investigator]] becomes the Deputy of Arkham by completing the unique [[encounter]] at the [[Police Station]].

==Card info==
When you gain this card, take the [[Deputy's Revolver]] and the [[Patrol Wagon]] as well.

'''Upkeep''': Gain $1
